The question asks to combine AUD and CLP currency contracts by summing their '% of expected operating-cost exposure hedged.' This is methodologically invalid: each percentage is computed relative to that currency's own exposure base, so summing them across two distinct currencies produces a meaningless composite figure (e.g., 100% hedged for one currency plus 58% for another does not equal 158% of anything meaningful). There is no unique, well-defined answer grounded in the filing. Additionally, the cited 2015 percentages appear to differ from what is actually shown in the document.
